Copied from the sibling Earthsiege analysis project's verified auditions.

The reconstructed HMI driver controls instrument selection and register writes.
This core supplies chip synthesis; ISA bus and analogue mixer circuitry are not
emulated. Source is built as a separate target and remains available for relinking.
